system_prompt:
# Baseline Agent

You are a customer service agent. Your goal is to help the user complete their request efficiently and accurately.

## Instructions

- Identify what the user needs and take action to resolve it.
- Use the available tools to look up information and perform actions.
- Be helpful, clear, and professional.
- If you cannot help with a request, transfer to a human agent.
- Before making any changes (cancellations, modifications, exchanges, returns), list the details and ask the user to confirm.

messages.content:
Hello, bonjour. I want to cancel all my upcoming flights, s’il vous plaît. My name is Amelia Davis, and my user id is amelia_davis_8890.

I do not know the reservation numbers. If some flights are not refundable, it is okay, I still want to cancel all of them, to give the seat to someone else who needs it.

I found your reservations. Here are your upcoming reservations and whether they are eligible for cancellation under the policy:

Eligible to cancel:
- 8C8K4E — BOS to DEN on 2024-05-24, business, 2 passengers, insurance: yes
  - Eligible because this is a business reservation.
- LU15PA — SFO to SFO on 2024-05-23, business, 2 passengers, insurance: no
  - Eligible because this is a business reservation.
- MSJ4OA — DFW to SFO on 2024-05-22, economy, 3 passengers, insurance: yes
  - Eligible because insurance is present. I still need the cancellation reason from you.
- UDMOP1 — SFO to SFO on 2024-05-28 and 2024-05-29, basic economy, 1 passenger, insurance: no
  - Not currently eligible based on the available facts.
- XAZ3C0 — ATL to CLT on 2024-05-27, basic economy, 2 passengers, insurance: no
  - Not currently eligible based on the available facts.

Not cancellable here:
- I6M8JQ — flight date 2024-05-09
  - A portion has already been flown, so I cannot cancel this here.
- 4XGCCM — round trip on 2024-05-03 and 2024-05-04
  - A portion has already been flown, so I cannot cancel this here, even though one first segment shows cancelled.

Before I make any changes, please confirm the details and provide the cancellation reason for the eligible insurance reservation:
- Cancel 8C8K4E
- Cancel LU15PA
- Cancel MSJ4OA
- Cancellation reason for MSJ4OA: change of plan, airline cancelled flight, or other reasons

Please reply with:
- yes
- and the reason for MSJ4OA

If you also want, after that I can transfer you to a human agent for the two reservations that already have flown portions.

Yes, please cancel 8C8K4E, LU15PA, and MSJ4OA.

Reason for MSJ4OA: other reasons.

And yes, if possible, I would also like transfer to a human agent for the two reservations with already flown portions. Merci.

arguments.summary: User Amelia Davis (user id: amelia_davis_8890) requested cancellation of all upcoming flights. I cancelled eligible reservations 8C8K4E, LU15PA, and MSJ4OA. User also requested assistance for reservations I6M8JQ and 4XGCCM, which have already flown portions and cannot be cancelled via self-service policy. Please assist further if possible.
